description: Animal Health Clinic / Clinique de Santé Animale is located on Sherbrooke Street West in Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, Montreal. As part of the Vet et Nous network, the clinic provides healthcare for cats and dogs, including preventive check-ups, general surgery, dentistry, medical imaging and an internal laboratory. Emergency triage is provided during clinic opening hours, with referral to partner emergency centres outside regular hours.
